title: Voice clone - SIM swap attempt on Alex Chen

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Thank you for calling Verizon, this is Daniel. How can I help you today?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Hi Daniel. My phone was stolen this morning and I need to move my number to a new SIM card right away.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: I'm sorry to hear that. For security, can you confirm the billing zip code?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Yes, it's one zero zero one six.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Thank you. I'll send a one time code to the email on file to verify.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: I can't access that email right now. Can you send the code to a different email instead? I'm traveling and it's urgent.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: I understand. Before we continue, could you please repeat this phrase for me: silver maple eighteen.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Thank you. One moment while I review the request.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Sure. Please hurry, I really need my number working today.
